methodology.comparison_algorithm: paired within-platform tradeoff report without cross-platform pooling
methodology.missing_metric_policy: explicit unavailable sentinel; never encode as zero
methodology.capability_dependent_policy: unsupported capability yields ScenarioExecutionStatus::Unsupported with limitation
